Transpose[QP0]; C = Inverse[R]; Λ = Transpose[C] . L . C; V = (1/2)*(Λ[[1,1]] + Λ[[2,2]] + Λ[[3,3]]); W = Λ[[1,1]]*Λ[[2,2]] + Λ[[1,1]]*Λ[[3,3]] + Λ[[2,2]]*Λ[[3,3]] - Λ[[3,1]]*Λ[[1,3]] - Λ[[1,2]]*Λ[[2,1]] - Λ[[2,3]]*Λ[[3,2]]; If[debug, Print["QP0,εP,R,C,Λ,V,W", Simplify[{QP0, εP, R, C, Λ, V, W}]]]; nfast = Simplify[Sqrt[(V - Sqrt[V^2 - W])/W]]; nslow = Simplify[Sqrt[(V + Sqrt[V^2 - W])/W]]; If[Element[Flatten[Chop[εP]], Reals], If[reflect, θguess = Pi - θi, θguess = θi]; , If[reflect, θguess = Pi - θi + 0.1*I, θguess = θi + 0.1*I]; ]; Quiet[sol = FindRoot[Sin[θt]*nfast == n0*Sin[θi], {θt, θguess}]]; θtfast = θt /. sol; nfast = nfast /. sol; Quiet[sol = FindRoot[Sin[θt]*nslow == n0*Sin[θi], {θt, θguess}]]; θtslow = θt /. sol; nslow = nslow /. sol; If[debug, Print["θfast and θslow from Snell's law:
